Without baseline call counts or controlled comparisons, this does not establish causation. Replay outputs demonstrate descriptive measurements and explicit uncertainty, not task completion or token savings. Three seeds cannot establish generalization, and aggregate means lack variability estimates. Neither required benefit has supporting evidence, so stopping is not recommended.
